description: Create a DRAFT product in the store. Nothing goes live: show the user the draft (name, description, price) and ask them to approve before calling publish. Pass the store's agent_key (returned by open_store).

agent_key.description: The store's agent key (rpy_…), returned by open_store

delivery_url.description: Optional https link buyers get after paying (file, repo, Notion page, ...). The owner can instead upload the file itself in the dashboard.

description.description: One or two sentences buyers will read

price_usd.description: Price in US dollars, paid in USDC (1 USDC = 1 USD)

type.description: What kind of product it is

name: create_product
title: Draft a product
